::: {.qube-card}
### Celebrating Youth-Led Quantitative Health Research
The **QUBE Youth Research Showcase Symposium** brings together students from the [QUBE Youth Scholars Network](youth-scholars-network.qmd) and [QUBE Discovery Lab](discovery-lab.qmd) to present their analytical projects and scientific findings.
:::

## Symposium Highlights

- **Student Research Presentations:** Middle and high school scholars present data-driven research addressing challenges in biology, medicine, environmental health, and public health.
- **Expert Feedback:** Receive constructive feedback and mentorship from QUBE's [Board Directors, Expert Advisors, and Graduate Student Advisors](../leadership/advisors.qmd).
- **Global Community Exchange:** Connect with youth researchers across QUBE's [U.S. and international branches](../leadership/branch-leadership.qmd).
